help.author: Author:
help.noUpdates: You are on the latest version.
help.shortcutUndo: Undo the last action that offers Undo (all on or off, apply to all, sorting, removing a favorite)
help.howActive: It is the one Scenes, the sidebar card and the system tray control. Change it from Scenes or by picking another bulb in the list.
help.howTray: When you close the window, WiZ APP stays next to the Windows clock. From its icon you turn everything on or off and apply your favorites. To close it for good, choose Quit in that menu.
help.howFavorites: Mark a scene with the heart and you will find it in every bulb's detail and in the tray menu.
help.howOffline: It did not answer in time. Check that it is plugged in and on the same Wi-Fi network, then press Retry. Your list does not change.
help.howAddTitle: A bulb that does not show up
help.howAdd: Add it with its IP address in Bulbs → Add bulb. You find it in your router or in the WiZ app.
